why.heading: Understanding Search Behavior in Sri Lanka
why.body: Sri Lanka's search market is bilingual and mobile-first, which most SEO advice ignores. A huge share of searches happen on phones, often mixing English and Sinhala or Tamil terms, and Google's local results in Colombo, Kandy, and Galle behave differently from international queries targeting tourists or export buyers. Tourism businesses compete globally for visitor searches while serving locally, and exporters need an entirely different keyword strategy aimed at overseas buyers. The best SEO expert in Sri Lanka has to handle both: dominating local map results at home while building the content authority that wins international rankings. Mobile speed is non-negotiable in a market where the phone is the primary device.

why.q: Do I need a Google Business Profile in Sri Lanka?
why.a: Absolutely, it is free and often the first thing customers see. For Colombo, Kandy, and Galle searches, the map pack decides most local outcomes.

why.q: How long does SEO take to work in Sri Lanka?
why.a: Most businesses see early movement in 2 to 3 months and meaningful results in 4 to 6. Less saturated than Western markets, so well-executed SEO often moves faster here.

faqs.q: Why do most SEO strategies fail in Sri Lanka?
faqs.a: Because they are built for Western markets: desktop-first, English-only, and obsessed with backlinks while the site loads slowly on the phones customers actually use. Sri Lanka needs mobile speed, bilingual content and easy contact paths first.

faqs.q: Should my website be in Sinhala, Tamil or English?
faqs.a: Sinhala and English cover most local business needs; Tamil matters in the north and east and for specific audiences. I map your actual customer languages in the audit rather than guessing.

faqs.q: How important is WhatsApp for my business?
faqs.a: Critical. A huge share of Sri Lankan enquiries happen over WhatsApp, not email or contact forms. If reaching you on WhatsApp is not effortless, you are losing customers daily.

faqs.q: How long does SEO take in Sri Lanka?
faqs.a: Local competition is often weak, so fundamentals, speed, profile, reviews, bilingual content, can move rankings in 2 to 3 months. Tourism keywords targeting foreign planners need a longer runway.

faqs.a: I work across South Asia from Pakistan, in the same time zone, with the same mobile-first realities. I do not import Western playbooks; I build for how your customers actually search and buy.
